description_en: Queries the available existing certificates for a specified domain name, that is, certificates that are already managed in SSL Certificates Service
description_zh: 获取指定域名可选的已有证书，即已在SSL证书中进行管理的证书
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-certificates --instance-id waf-cn-zz11sr50000 --domain www.aliyundoc.com --resource-group-id rg-aekzz2e0000pp7i --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCertificates

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name for which you want to query the associated SSL certificates.

If you do not set this parameter, the SSL certificates associated with all domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询关联SSL证书的域名。

不设置该参数表示查询所有域名关联的SSL证书
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
